Bug_Details:
Avoid the use temporary objects when converting primitives to Strings. Use the static conversion methods
on the wrapper classes instead.
Examples:
public String convert(int x) {
    String foo = new Integer(x).toString(); // this wastes an object

    return Integer.toString(x);             // preferred approach
}
Bug_Explanation: The UnnecessaryConversionTemporary bug occurs when an object is created explicitly instead of using static conversion methods on the wrapper classes. This unnecessary object creation wastes memory and can lead to performance issues.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case triggers the bug by calling the'showBug' method, which contains the unnecessary object creation. The test case fails by expecting the result to be not equal to the string '5', which is the expected result.
